entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: AVX10.2 saturating floating point to integer conversions #117573
  • feature: ildasm new flag to preserve ldstr raw string values #117570
  • Expose floating-point constants for generic Vector types using extension properties #117569
  • Title: NullReferenceException in ComInterop.ExcepInfo when GetExceptionForHR returns null #117568
  • Collectible assembly freed while in use in .NET 10 #117566
    10.0.0
  • RuntimeBinder tests fail finding `IsType` method #117565

Closed

  • Possible exception handling sequence error in the runtime #117559
  • malformed uint.TryParse docs #115715
  • Cannot reading certificates from MAUI App on Mac OS #100133
    Future
  • Proposal: Folding generic methods in NativeAOT #117564
  • X25519 should be consistently supported where possible #42312
  • Fix regression which could cause ODE during configuration binding #117491
    10.0.0
  • C# Math.Pow(-1, 2) doesn't output correct value on Windows 11 Insider Preview, Canary channel (27881.1000) #117233

PullRequests

Created

  • [RuntimeAsync] Make JitOptimizeAwait not a release switch. #117574
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Add support for some more simd folding to improve the new IndexOf and related helpers #117572
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: Move remaining xarch floating->integral cast implementation to lowering #117571
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution

Merged

  • Adding proper exiting and cleanup logic for singlefile createdump #117286
    needs-area-label
  • Protect against ODE when accessing configuration providers #117551
    area-Extensions-Configuration, 10.0.0

Updated

  • [WIP] TLS 1.3 on OSX support #117428
    area-System.Net.Security
  • JIT: Fix removal of intermediate double cast in long->double->float chains #117554
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Expose the x86 WaitPkg intrinsics #117437
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, linkable-framework
  • Fixing performance regression in EventSource #117549
    area-System.Diagnostics.Tracing
  • Simplify collection enumerators #117563
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
  • Fix Infinite loop on OdbcDataReader.internalGetString with UTF-8 text #117192
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • [WIP] Composite ML-DSA Managed Composer #117259
    area-System.Security
  • [EventPipe] End user_events session upon continuation_stream closure #117435
    area-Tracing-coreclr
  • JIT: Allow containment of CnsVec under GetElement node with non-const index #117562
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix RISC-V JIT build #117553
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • GetAppDomainList cDAC implementation #117515
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • GetAssemblyModuleList cDAC implementation #117452
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [RISC-V] Conditional simple operations #116581
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv
